purpose: Research-only contract audit of the October 26 first-light Montrose observations; repeated records collapse to one date/site-group candidate and never become a whole-cell, whole-morning, or clean training negative.

source_receipt.assessment_basis: validated upstream three-frame vision; no independent pixel review

method: Require an in-window immutable observation record, fresh/healthy primary contact camera, at least moderate visibility and detectability, and no visual event evidence. Restrict any negative evidence to the visible 437 Montrose waterline/beach segments. Collapse repeated records by local date and independent site group. Preserve public/social effort, whole-morning outcome, and unresolved environmental matching dimensions as UNKNOWN. Do not infer a control for Point Clear from marina/Bay views.
blockers_before_tier_a_or_training_use: Independent biological review or observation channel sufficient to label the visible interval
Known same-window public/social or human observation effort, or an explicit admissible missingness rule
Defensible whole-window coverage rather than two isolated first-light samples
Matched confirmed event window with comparable season, clock time, tide/current context, and observation availability
Accepted nearshore observed-current or transport phase; predicted tide alone is insufficient
Temporal-availability audit for every contextual feature
rationale: The two fresh first-light Montrose observations satisfy the camera-specific contract for a narrow visible-scope candidate and collapse to one additional candidate morning. They do not establish a whole-morning or full-cell non-event, lack an independent biological label, and do not unlock oxygen-only, transport-only, or combined held-out Jubilee evaluation.
guardrails: No-report silence is never a negative.
Point Clear marina/Bay views do not establish a close-shore control.
Predicted tide and regional proxies do not substitute for observed nearshore current or direct bottom oxygen.
No production probability, weight, threshold, cadence, camera, schedule, UNKNOWN rule, or 9 PM gate changes.
